== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* His nickname stands for "words of blessing" in Korean.
* Known for his {{ci|Aphelios}}.
* Reached 1000 kills in the LCK on March 4th, 2023.
** Was the 21st player to reach 1000 kills in the LCK, after [[Faker]], [[PraY]], [[Bang]], [[Score]], [[Kuro]], [[Smeb]], [[Ambition]], [[Sangyoon]], [[Deft]], [[Teddy]], [[Ruler]], [[Bdd]], [[Ghost (Jang Yong-jun)|Ghost]], [[Peanut]], [[Chovy]], [[Fly (Song Yong-jun)|Fly]], [[ShowMaker]], [[Kiin]], [[Aiming]] and [[Rascal]].
=== Awards ===
